title: Isolation and qPCR for S. Typhi detection from River Water Samples
author: Nicholas Feasey
materials: Change gloves and clean surfaces with 80% ethanol.
Retrieve place directly into sterile Whirl-Pak bag.
Pick presumptive colonies for molecular confirmation.
Include controls: NTC qPCR Negative Positive control
700 μL transferred into a deep 96-well plate
The plate was loaded onto the QiaSymphony

steps.title: Select sites and record metadata
steps.instruction: Use GIS‑informed mapping to identify candidate water bodies, record GPS coordinates, assess accessibility and safety, and complete the site metadata form with date/time, weather, recent rainfall, visible contamination, sample type(s), and field team ID.

steps.title: Collect water sample
steps.instruction: Submerge a sterile Nalgene bottle ~30 cm below the surface upstream of the sampler, collect 1 L of water, seal the bottle, and log sample ID, collection time, temperature, turbidity, pH, and conductivity.

steps.title: Prepare and deploy Moore swab
steps.instruction: Fold sterile gauze into a pleated accordion, tie the centre securely with sterile fishing line (1–2 m retrieval length), attach the line to a stable structure, place the swab into mid‑stream, label the deployment bag, and log deployment duration, retrieval time, and any swab loss events.

steps.title: Transport and store samples
steps.instruction: Place all samples in cooler boxes at 2–8 °C, transport to the laboratory within 3 h (maximum 6–8 h). If processing is delayed, store at 4 °C and process within 24 h, recording arrival condition and any temperature deviations.

steps.title: Filter water sample
steps.instruction: Filter as much of the 1 L water sample as possible through a 0.45 µm membrane; if a filter blocks, replace it (up to 5 membranes total); stop filtering after 1 h per sample and record the volume of any unfiltered water.

steps.title: Add bile broth to filters and swabs
steps.instruction: Resuspend each filter in 10 mL 2 % bile broth; for each Moore swab, submerge the whole swab in 250 mL 2 % bile broth.

steps.title: Incubate bile broth
steps.instruction: Incubate the bile‑broth suspensions at 37 ± 2 °C for 18–24 h.

steps.title: Transfer to Selenite F broth
steps.instruction: Aseptically transfer 5 mL of each incubated bile broth into 5 mL double‑strength Selenite F broth.

steps.title: Incubate Selenite broth
steps.instruction: Incubate the Selenite F broths at 41 ± 2 °C for 12–18 h under static conditions and label each broth with its sample ID and time.

steps.title: Plate onto mCASE agar
steps.instruction: Plate each culture onto modified Chromogenic Agar Salmonella esterase (mCASE) media using three methods:

steps.title: Incubate plates and inspect colonies
steps.instruction: Incubate the mCASE plates at 37 °C for 18–24 h and observe for blue‑green colonies indicative of S. Typhi.

steps.title: Boilate DNA extraction from colonies
steps.instruction: For each suspect colony, add 500 µL nuclease‑free water to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, heat at 96 °C for 10 min, pick 1–2 colonies and emulsify in the tube, then centrifuge at full speed for 5 s to remove condensation.

steps.title: Sub‑culture ttr‑positive colonies
steps.instruction: Sub‑culture all colonies with appropriate morphology and a positive ttr gene onto fresh mCASE agar and incubate at 37 °C for 18–24 h.

steps.title: Cryopreserve pure isolates
steps.instruction: Harvest all pure growth and place into Microbank Cryopreservation Beads; if cultures are not pure, repeat sub‑culturing until purity is achieved.

steps.title: Archive suspected S. Typhi isolates
steps.instruction: Separate and archive all isolates that amplify ttr, tviB, and staG from non‑typhoidal Salmonella isolates.

steps.title: Store cryobeads at ultra‑low temperature
steps.instruction: Store all cryobeads at –80 °C, minimizing freeze‑thaw cycles to preserve viability.

steps.title: Prepare isolates for whole‑genome sequencing
steps.instruction: Retrieve a bead from the tube, place it onto non‑selective agar, make a pool with the bead, streak for single colonies, and incubate at 37 °C for 18–24 h.

steps.title: Confirm purity of sequencing isolates
steps.instruction: Take half of a colony for qPCR and sub‑culture the other half as described previously; proceed only when purity is confirmed.

steps.title: Grow culture for DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Inoculate a 1 µL loop of bacterial growth from nutrient agar into 1.5 mL nutrient broth and incubate at 37 ± 1 °C for 18–20 h.

steps.title: Heat‑inactivate and lyse cells
steps.instruction: Heat‑inactivate the culture at 95 ± 2 °C for 10 min, centrifuge 20 min at 2,500 × g, discard supernatant, add 220 µL ATL buffer and 20 µL proteinase K, and incubate at 60 ± 5 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: RNase treatment
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL RNase and incubate for 15 min at 37 ± 1 °C.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA
steps.instruction: Extract DNA using the DSP Virus/Pathogen Mini‑Kit with the default extraction profile on the instrument.

steps.title: Quantify DNA yield and purity
steps.instruction: Determine DNA yield and purity with the Qubit 1× dsDNA Broad Range Assay kit.

steps.title: Set up qPCR for S. Typhi detection
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL reaction mix (details as per laboratory standard); run qPCR targeting ttr, tviB, and staG. A positive sample amplifies all three targets with Ct < 38. Record Ct values, amplification plots, and annotate any inconclusive or single‑target results for retesting.
